# Arthur Fouray Systems

> Official website and active archive of Arthur Fouray (born 9 May 1990, Paris), French artist and curator. The site maps his production as artist, curator, publisher and musician (as rt4a), organised as an interface-driven book inspired by Duchamp's La Boîte verte (1934).

Preferred name: Arthur Fouray. Music alias: rt4a. Contact and press: see the Curriculum Vitae page.

## Main pages

- [Curriculum Vitae](https://arthurfouray.systems/curriculum-vitae): full CV, exhibitions, curatorial work, publications, teaching.
- [Exhibition Making](https://arthurfouray.systems/exhibition-making): curated exhibitions and essays, including work at DOC, Paris and Silicon Malley, Lausanne.
- [Arthur Fouray Spectre](https://arthurfouray.systems/arthur-fouray-spectre): painting series and the 2015 solo show "Spectre" at Espace Quark, Geneva.
- [PPP+](https://arthurfouray.systems/ppplus): 620 playing cards, online, physical and NFT, 2023 to 2025.
- [Music](https://arthurfouray.systems/music): releases as rt4a, including Scheherazade Op. 35 versions and 2025 singles.
- [RT4A Index](https://arthurfouray.systems/rt4a-index): index of the rt4a project.
- [RT4A Welcome to the art world](https://arthurfouray.systems/rt4a-welcome-to-the-art-world)
